The only university that was ranked in the *top 10* of the Times Higher Education World University Rankings for **every year 2020‑2022** **and** had an **International Outlook** score of **less than 75** in the 2018 rankings is:

| University | 2018 International Outlook (score out of 100) |
|------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Yale University | 68.7 |

All other schools that remained in the top‑10 across those three years (Oxford, Caltech, Cambridge, Stanford, MIT, Princeton, Harvard, Chicago, Imperial) had International Outlook scores of 75 or higher in 2018.
